_comment: Blocked A26 variation for the unported hero-pack ignition path: this independent wizard setup aims to wish an oil lamp and a blessed scroll of fire, read the scroll, dismiss its prompts, toggle getpos highlighting, and center the blast on the hero. The source target is explode.c:explode -> trap.c:ignite_items -> apply.c:catch_lit; the existing JS catch_item_light() still refuses eligible objects in OBJ_INVENT. The recipe has not yet been independently recorded, so it is retained as a source-named coverage blocker and is not matching completion evidence.
